project_type: Bun 1.3.14 TypeScript monorepo (React 19.2 + MUI 9.2 web, Expo compatibility client, native SwiftUI iOS) with Python 3.13 FastAPI + Strawberry GraphQL services (api, gateway, assistant) on PostgreSQL 17
language: Python (services/api, services/gateway) and TypeScript (packages/core, apps/web, apps/mobile, scripts); Swift test fixture only; Bash (scripts/start-local.sh)
build_system: Bun workspaces (apps/*, packages/*, tests/*). Python venvs live in .local/api-venv and .local/gateway-venv (already installed). No ESLint/Prettier/Ruff: follow surrounding style and the deterministic guard scripts.
test_framework: pytest (services/api/tests, services/gateway/tests; real-Postgres tests create a throwaway schema on TEST_PG_DSN, default 'host=localhost port=5432 dbname=postgres user=rhub password=rhub-dev-pwd', skip locally if PG is down, fail in CI); bun test (packages/core, apps/web/src, apps/mobile/tests); Playwright sealed suite tests/e2e-app (needs a web dev server on :5180); swift test in apps/ios/PattadarKit; scripts/*-tests.ts guards.
build_command: bun run typecheck (all workspaces); per package: bun run --filter @pattadar/web typecheck, bun run --filter @pattadar/mobile typecheck, bun run --filter @pattadar/core typecheck
test_command: API: cd services/api && ../../.local/api-venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -rs [tests/<file>]  (baseline full suite: 528 passed). Gateway: .local/gateway-venv/bin/python -m pytest services/gateway/tests -q. TS: bun test packages/core apps/web/src apps/mobile/tests apps/university/src. Guards: for s in scripts/*-tests.ts; do bun run "$s"; done; bun run scripts/icon-guard.ts; bun run scripts/ux-guards.ts; bun run scripts/parity-check.ts. AI boundary: .local/api-venv/bin/python scripts/ai-boundary-guard.py --selftest && .local/api-venv/bin/python scripts/ai-boundary-guard.py. iOS: cd apps/ios/PattadarKit && swift test --filter DocSpineTests. e2e: cd tests/e2e-app && bunx playwright test specs/07-record-people.spec.ts --project=app -g "Aadhaar".
verification_instructions: 1) Run the FEAT's own verification commands. 2) For code changes run the typecheck of touched packages and the relevant tests. 3) UI/CSS/icon changes run every scripts/*-tests.ts plus icon-guard and ux-guards (typography-tests.ts TY-5 failure at apps/university/src/styles.css font-weight 800 is a PRE-EXISTING baseline; anything else must pass). 4) Cross-client contract changes run bun run scripts/parity-check.ts. 5) Record exact commands and results in the FEAT 'findings'. 6) State anything not run (e.g. Playwright when no :5180 server, swift when no toolchain).
